page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg9a.64xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal server belonging to the ECS Bare Metal family. The system is equipped with an AMD EPYC 9T25 processor providing 256 dedicated virtual cores running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Memory capacity reaches 1152 GB, which corresponds to 4.5 GB of RAM per vCPU. The platform contains no hardware graphics acceleration, focusing system resources entirely on general-purpose processing across its dedicated cores.

Network connectivity features a high baseline bandwidth of 128 Gbps, catering to heavy network transit requirements. Local storage is not provided with this instance type, meaning persistent storage requirements must be met using remote cloud storage volumes. This architectural choice decouples compute from disk, allowing scalable storage provisioning at the expense of local disk I/O latency. From a resource perspective, the high vCPU and memory density eliminates virtualization overhead while consolidating large computing demands into a single deployment unit.

Due to its balanced memory-to-core ratio and vast parallel processing capabilities, ecs.ebmg9a.64xlarge fits multi-core enterprise applications. Core deployment scenarios include in-memory databases, large-scale web serving clusters, distributed ETL data pipelines, continuous integration systems, and dense virtualization or container environments requiring non-virtualized CPU access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg9a.64xlarge is a high-density bare-metal server from the ECS Bare Metal family designed for large enterprise deployments. Powered by AMD EPYC 9T25 processors on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 256 dedicated virtual cores operating at 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 1152 GB, delivering a balanced ratio of 4.5 GB of RAM per core without onboard GPU accelerators. Network connectivity delivers 128 Gbps of baseline bandwidth to handle heavy inter-system communication. The platform lacks integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for system and application data. This setup provides massive multi-core throughput and memory capacity in a single physical instance. The configuration is suited for large database systems, ETL processing, massive container hosting, and demanding general-purpose enterprise applications.
